head: codex/5833-birth-witness
title: [v0.92][WP-15] Birth witnesses and receipts
body:
Closes danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5833

## Summary
- add an opaque runtime-established four-role Ed25519 birth-witness authority bound to the exact accepted Birthday candidate, reviewed evidence set, roster, and generation
- derive canonical accepted/rejected witness sets and path-redacted citizen receipts whose birth status remains `not_claimed`
- reject self-provisioned roots, case-variant equivocation, missing/duplicate/stale/forged/substituted witnesses, unsafe evidence, secret-bearing paths, packet tamper, unknown fields, and premature birth claims
- add the narrow WP-15 exact-head native Linux/macOS receipt workflow with exact structured 13-test authority inventory and success-only eight-file aggregation

## Validation
- crate-internal authority lane: 13/13 passed
- public serialization boundary: 1/1 passed
- external authority compile-fail: 1/1 passed
- strict Clippy, formatting, producer/validator Ruby syntax and self-tests, workflow YAML, diff hygiene, and typed validation: passed
- independent exact-head review: APPROVED with no actionable P1/P2 findings
- exact native Linux/macOS/aggregate proof remains required after publication before final review and merge

## Non-claims
This PR does not claim a birth event, legal personhood, citizenship, governance approval, public launch, or raw private-state disclosure.
